t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The other participant said that the brown, purple, pink and yellow gnomes lead to more mushrooms but it varies somewhat

vb_textbox.text: It is hard to determine exactly what color gnomes give the most mushrooms. It seems to fluctuate pretty often. I will say that rather than trying to focus on specific colors it may be a better approach to treat each round as a separate part with new values. The best advice I can give is to use your intuition and try to follow the almost constantly changing trends.
